About Me

A marketer who treats your brand like her own

Growth, measured, not guessed

Hello! I'm Abigail Tetteh, a freelance digital marketer and marketing graduate who loves helping brands grow, connect, and sell online. With a mix of strategy, creativity, and data, I turn social media into revenue and followers into loyal customers.

Whether you're a startup finding your voice, a service business chasing better leads, or an ecommerce brand ready to scale, I build marketing systems that get results: professionally trained, obsessed with analytics, and focused on ROI rather than vanity metrics. I work remotely with clients locally in Ghana and worldwide.
